parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Commence integration by parts and reach $Ax^2\cos2x-\int Bx\cos2x\,dx$ - *M1. OE; condone a sign error in the formula.

Obtain $-\dfrac12x^2\cos2x+\int x\cos2x\,dx$ - A1; OE; unsimplified.

Complete integration by parts and reach $Ax^2\cos2x+Bx\sin2x+C\cos2x$ - *M1. OE; the second integral may be written separately for M1 but not A1.

Obtain $-\dfrac12x^2\cos2x+\dfrac12x\sin2x+\dfrac14\cos2x$ - A1; OE; unsimplified.

Substitute correct limits in that form and evaluate the trig expressions - DM1. Guidance: $A(\pi/6)^2(1/2)+B(\pi/6)(\sqrt3/2)+C(1/2)-C$; allow one slip including omitting $-C$; do not allow only decimals.

Obtain $-\pi^2/144+\sqrt3\pi/24-1/8$ or exact three-term equivalent - A1; ISW; allow equivalent fractions and $0.125$ for $1/8$.

Printed total: 6.
